config.mxt.server.cultivation.allow_move: Let a cultivator move slowly while meditating.
config.mxt.server.cultivation.forbid_wit: Only cultivate where the aura or the realm requirement is met.
config.mxt.server.cultivation.technique_: Item cooldown in ticks after learning or failing to learn a technique; 0 disables it.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.enabled.toolt: The master switch. Off means the whole lifespan line stands still: no settlement, no seeding, no expiry, no warning and no row on the character panel, and the attachment is not even read; turning it on resumes the ledgers from that moment and never back-pays the time it was off. It defaults to off, so upgrading changes nothing. Writes from data packs and commands are unaffected - they still record, they just do not run down.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.base_lifespan: The lifespan a body receives on first login (and on the first settlement of a body that has a ledger nobody ever granted life to), in ticks, once the master switch is on. 0 disables seeding, so only bodies a data pack or a command named are bound by it. Reincarnation recomputes to this value too. Lowering it never rewrites a body that is already accounted for.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.settle_interv: How many ticks pass between two settlements. Smaller is finer and costs more server time and more syncing: settling every tick means one sync packet per entity per tick.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.age_per_settl: How many ticks of life each settlement spends; its ratio to the settle interval is the rate (20/20 is normal, 20/40 is half speed, 40/20 is double). 0 settles without ageing. The countdown runs on entity ticks, so it does not pass while offline and logging back in never back-pays.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.on_expire.too: What happens when the lifespan reaches zero and nobody extends it. Death: a player is turned into a spectator (no item loss, no death event) while a non-player creature dies outright. Reincarnate: the body is washed back to a mortal on the spot, and what it keeps is on the Reincarnation tab. Nothing: only the event fires and content decides.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.warning_fract: The fraction of the ceiling at which the remaining lifespan warns once on the action bar - only on the crossing, not every settlement. 0 turns the warning off, and 1 never fires either: the remaining life is never above its own ceiling.
config.mxt.server.lifespan.ticks_per_yea: The divisor the character panel and the warning use to read ticks as years; 24000 ticks is one game day. Set it to 1 to show ticks.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.kills.to: On: the body goes through a real death before it is washed back to a mortal, so items drop, the death message is filled in and a respawn point is set. Off: nothing drops, no respawn point, no death event.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.reset_cu: Clears the body's realm stages, cultivation progress, sitting state and sitting cooldowns, so it is a mortal again and may break through the first stage afresh. The passive attributes and minor-stage abilities that came with those realms are taken back with them.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.clear_mi: Clears the record of how far the body ever got inside each realm. Left in place, content that gates on a stage count would keep treating the threshold as already reached after a rebirth.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.cancel_t: Drops a tribulation in progress without its success or its failure action, because the life it was testing for is over.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.clear_re: Empties every resource value the body holds (each is re-initialized from its definition on the next read). The base leaves resources alone by default - which resource counts as cultivation progress is a data pack's decision - so this switch zeroes them all.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.keep_spi: Keeps spirit roots, physiques and their enabled/disabled state. Off clears them along with the rest.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.keep_tec: Keeps learned techniques and their mastery levels - the memory stays while the foundation is rebuilt. Off clears them too.
config.mxt.server.reincarnation.keep_sou: Keeps karma, heart demon, soul strength and soul sense range. Off returns all four to zero.
Item cooldown in ticks after invoking a talisman by hand; 0 disables it. It covers every talisman the player holds, and while it runs a hand pour is refused too, so not even that tick of aura moves. A carrier standing on a display stand reads no window and leaves none.
config.mxt.server.aura.block_aura_tick_i: Ticks between block aura recalculations; smaller is more responsive and more expensive.
config.mxt.server.aura.entity_refresh_in: Ticks between aura recalculations for a still entity.
config.mxt.server.aura.sync_interval.too: Ticks between aura syncs to the client.
config.mxt.server.aura.query_stats.toolt: Log aura resolution timings every ten seconds, for diagnosis only.
config.mxt.server.formation.plate_auto_d: An unbound plate scans the formations its allow list admits, compares structures, raises the nearest match and names it. Off requires /mxt formation bind first.
config.mxt.server.formation.empty_plate_: What an empty allow list means: on permits any formation, off requires every plate to list what it may run.
config.mxt.server.formation.draws_enviro: The ambient aura of the ground also pays a formation's upkeep; off uses only what the formation's own blocks supply.
config.mxt.server.formation.respect_frie: Whether a formation that declares spare_friends spares the owner's friends, the owner included, FTB Teams members and allies included. Off makes such formations affect everyone.
config.mxt.server.formation.teammates_ca: Let the owner's friends, FTB Teams members and allies included, take the formation down; off leaves it to the owner and operators, and an entity nobody can identify is refused either way. Off by default.
config.mxt.server.flight.follow_look.too: On: forward and backward follow the look direction (look up to climb, look down to dive) while strafing stays level. Off: all four directions stay on the horizontal plane. Jumping up and the descend key work either way.
